assay: bulk RNA-seq of liver, DNBseq PE150, HISAT2 to GRCm39

primary_estimand: Effect of 6 weeks of chronic moderate-intensity treadmill exercise on the mouse liver transcriptome (Exe vs Con, independent animals)
